description: Battle-shock tests must be ROLLED IN FRONT OF THE PLAYER, one unit at a time, instead of auto-resolving into the game log. Drives the real roll call through the real UI: the panel's RESOLVE BATTLE-SHOCK button opens the sequence dialog; it shows 'TEST 1 OF 2' for the first unit with its strength + the reason it must test; the camera pans to that unit and its models get focus rings; pressing Roll tumbles the dice and lands a verdict; Next walks to unit 2 (camera moves again); Finish shows the summary; Close restores the camera. Player CP is zeroed first so a failed test cannot branch into the Command Re-roll offer (covered separately by the Insane Bravery segment at the end).

steps.script:
# Two P2 units owe a test: Kommandos are already at half strength (5/10);
# set Boyz E to exactly 8 of 20 alive so it is BELOW half strength too
# (its attached Warboss makes the combined unit 9 of 21).
var boyz = GameState.state["units"]["U_BOYZ_E"]
for i in range(boyz["models"].size()):
	boyz["models"][i]["alive"] = i < 8
# Rebuild the tokens so the board shows the casualties we just applied —
# otherwise the focus rings would be asserted against a stale board.
SceneRefs.main()._recreate_unit_visuals()
# Zero CP so a failed test cannot branch into the Command Re-roll pause.
GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"] = 0
var cp = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
cp._units_tested.clear()
cp._identify_units_needing_tests()
return cp._units_needing_test.size()

var q = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().get_battle_shock_queue()
return [q[0]["unit_id"], q[0]["reason"], q[1]["unit_id"], q[1]["reason"]]

# A real player answers the start-of-phase prompts (secondary-mission review,
# Beacon / Condemn designations, ...) before reaching for the command panel.
# Those are EXCLUSIVE windows, so a real mouse click on the panel underneath
# goes nowhere until they are gone — clear whatever this fixture opened so the
# click under test is the only thing in play.
var closed = []
for c in tree.root.get_children():
	if c is Window and c != tree.root:
		closed.append(String(c.name))
		c.hide()
		c.queue_free()
return true

# 'Roll the rest for me' resolves everything still outstanding and lands on
# the summary — the old silent behaviour, now as an explicit choice.
var phase = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
var heading = tree.root.get_node("BattleShockSequenceDialog/Content/HeadingLabel").text
return [phase.get_untested_battle_shock_units().is_empty(), heading]
